body.name: Total-Gram-stabilized local-polynomial estimator
body.construction: Split the sample into \(I_0,I_1,I_2\). Set \(\widehat\nu_n=|I_0|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_0}Y_i\mathbf 1\{A_i>\delta_n\}\), \(\widehat b_x=|I_1|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_1}\mathbf 1\{X_i=x,A_i\leq\delta_n\}\), and \(\widetilde\mu_x=\Pi_{[0,1]}(\sum_{i\in I_2}w_{ix}Y_i)\) on \(\Omega_x\), with \(\widetilde\mu_x=1/2\) off \(\Omega_x\). Define \(\widehat\theta_n=\Pi_{[0,1]}[\widehat\nu_n+\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\widehat b_x\widetilde\mu_x]\).
